entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Nezumi who united three gangs and is called first lord.

entities.name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
entities.description: A Soratami who despises the nezumi yet finds them useful.

entities.name: Split-Tail
entities.description: Old nezumi who stole scrolls from the Minamo School.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: Rat folk whose first shamans were born after the theft.

events.summary: Marrow-Gnawer unites three nezumi gangs by slaying their leaders in a night.
events.quote: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night.

events.summary: Split-Tail steals scrolls from the Minamo School, leading to the first nezumi shamans.
events.quote: Four generations ago, old Split-Tail stole a bundle of scrolls from the Minamo School.

events.summary: Meloku voices disgust at the nezumi.

relations.quote: Now they call him their first lord.
